svg.aria-label: What makes up response time: the client sends a request, it travels over the network, waits in a queue at the server, is processed (the service time), and the reply travels back. Response time is everything the client sees; service time is only the processing; latency is time spent waiting, such as in the network or the queue. Under load, the queueing part grows fastest.
svg.title: What makes up response time: the client sends a request, it travels over the network, waits in a queue at the server, is processed (the service time), and the reply travels back. Response time is everything the client sees; service time is only the processing; latency is time spent waiting, such as in the network or the queue. Under load, the queueing part grows fastest.
svg.text: Under load the queue grows first: a server at 90% busy makes requests wait far longer than they take to process.
